name: gizza-ai/image-to-ascii
summary: Convert an image into ASCII or ANSI character art.

tool.description: Convert an image into ASCII or ANSI character art. The image is scaled to `width` characters wide (1-400, default 80; height is derived from the aspect ratio and corrected for tall text cells) and each cell's brightness is mapped through a character ramp from dark to light. Choose a built-in ramp (standard, detailed, or blocks) or supply a custom `charset` ordered dark→light. Use `brightness` (-1.0 to 1.0) to lighten/darken, color=true to wrap each character in a 24-bit ANSI truecolor escape for terminals, or invert=true for light-on-dark terminals. Returns the art plus the output character dimensions and source pixel dimensions. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

ramp.description: Character ramp: standard (10-level), detailed (70-level), or blocks (Unicode shading).

charset.description: Custom character ramp ordered dark→light (e.g. " .:-=+*#%@"). Overrides `ramp` when set; needs at least 2 characters.

color.description: Wrap each character in a 24-bit ANSI truecolor escape (for terminals).
